description: One public tracker, whatever its sources: what people follow on Monity Network. `sources` is ONE (the page it tracks, its health, followers, who runs it) or SEVERAL (each source a page Monity checks, credited to whoever publishes it, or an external source such as an agent, labelled; each source's health; its followers). Use get_network_changes with watch=<ref> (ONE) or watchlist=<ref> (SEVERAL) for what changed.
